operator.tariffChannel: direct CPO / ad-hoc; IONITY App without subscription tracked separately; subscriptions excluded from default direct tariff

italy.source: IONITY country pricing table current on 2026-09-22
italy.warning: IONITY explicitly states these are current minimum prices and the charging price at a station may be higher; therefore 0.85 cannot be deterministically applied to all IT*IOY EVSE.

positiveEvidence: IONITY current country pricing table exposes Italy Direct=0.85 EUR/kWh and Go=0.80 EUR/kWh.
IONITY states all displayed country prices are current minimum prices and the price at the charging station may be higher.

IONITY June 15 2026 pricing notice, effective July 1 2026, explicitly says station-specific pricing exists and Italy IONITY Direct/ad-hoc is up to 0.91 EUR/kWh; applicable price is shown in app or charger before session.
negativePaths: Do not promote 0.85 EUR/kWh to all IT*IOY EVSE: official first-party caveat disproves universal applicability.
Do not use subscription Power/Motion prices as direct/ad-hoc tariff.
Do not use country minima as station-level values without exact EVSE/station mapping.
operator.blockingCondition: deterministic IT*IOY EVSE/station -> current IONITY Direct price mapping from app, charger/QR, station endpoint or equivalent first-party payload
operator.resumeCondition: new exploitable first-party station-price endpoint/payload, QR surface, or proof that a single Italy Direct price again applies universally

canonicalUpdateRequired.setBlockingCondition: deterministic IT*IOY EVSE/station -> current IONITY Direct price mapping; country table is a minimum and station price may be higher
